process_behavior.meaning: The Council vote is the formal voting process at the regular session on 8 September 2026, where members physically present cast votes on Ordinance 2026-14. The process produces an official vote record. It runs once at the session, after the item is called and not postponed, provided quorum is present.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The process runs at the regular session on 8 September 2026, after the agenda item is called and if not postponed, and if at least three members are physically present.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: The process occurs exactly once at the 8 September 2026 session, as scheduled.
